what: Reorganization of README files and definition of GitHub Free distribution strategy
why: The user wanted to translate the README to English, set Spanish as secondary, and requested distribution options for Windows, macOS, and Linux using a free GitHub organization account.
learned: Moved Spanish README to README_ES.md and created a new English README.md as the main entry point to make the project accessible globally. Created a distribution plan using GitHub Free features: compiling cross-platform binaries using GoReleaser triggered by Git tags.
author: Mario Sandoval (Sv Tech)
